question: Town C is to the east of Town D. Town E is to the north of Town C. Town F is to the south of Town E. Town G is to the west of Town F. Town D is to the north-east of Town G. What is the position of Town C with respect to Town F?
solution:
**Given:**

Town C is to the east of Town D.

Town E is to the north of Town C.

Town F is to the south of Town E.

Town G is to the west of Town F.

Town D is to the north-east of Town G

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/326dd553fafd6b8de74396097f68a4a9cf89004623eee2e7194196a626bdbef2.png] 

Thus, the position of Town C with respect to Town F is North.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
